description: Ball Butler yaw-stage marker template, BB-local frame, for the constellation yaw-offset estimator (bb_calibration.estimate_constellation_yaw_offset).
frame: x/y: BB-local, x along BB yaw 0, rotation about world z, origin at session A's stored BB position (-975.55, -389.26) mm (the origin is irrelevant to the estimator). z: world z minus session A's stored BB z (1734.86 mm). Units mm.

gauge.pinned_on: mean of the estimator over the 7 calibration sweeps (0-deg pause) of rosbag 2026-10-09_18-56-37
gauge.frame_of: session 20261009T002142_931068Z stored pose: yaw offset 0.208 deg, position (-975.55, -389.26, 1734.86) mm - the frame resources/throw_affine_correction.json was fitted in
gauge.rule: BB has not moved since session A (owner, 2026-10-09). If BB is ever physically moved, the gauge must be re-pinned AND the aim correction refitted; calibrate with the mocap_node parameter bb_moved:=true to pass the consistency gate once.

provenance.template_from: session A bag /home/jetson/bb_calibration_sessions/20261009T002142_931068Z/bag (611 stationary holds, generalised Procrustes, label-free matching)
provenance.gauge_from: rosbag /home/jetson/Desktop/rosbags/2026-10-09_18-56-37 (7 calibration sweeps, BB untouched since session A)
provenance.scripts: Jugglebot worktree temp/bbyaw/ (extract.py, build_template.py, pin_gauge.py; not committed); logic from ~/bb_calibration_sessions/yaw_offset_investigation_20261009/
provenance.template_hold_rms_note: upper-plane 4-marker template; per-hold RMS (mm) over the matched holds: session A p50 0.217 / p99 0.646 / max 0.728 (489 holds), session B max 0.802 (204), new bag pauses 0.13-0.42 (7)

cross_check.note: see logbook/2026-10-09-bb-constellation-yaw-offset.md: the pinned gauge reads A/B in-session holds 0.25-0.38 deg lower than the new bag pauses; unexplained (park-yaw/backlash, re-home or QTM between sessions are candidates)

excluded_markers.why: The two off-plane markers (QTM 1 and 2, ~28 mm below the others, added 2026-09-27) distort at the parked yaw-0 pose: on the 7 sweeps of the 18:56 bag their inclusion raises the per-sweep scatter from 0.095 to 0.297 deg and the hold RMS from ~0.25 to ~0.8 mm; QTM 1 was already the marker whose parked readings crept ~3 mm on 2026-10-05/06. Kept here for reference only; the estimator does not use them.

markers_note: QTM labels are NOT used. At build time these were (by position): m0 = QTM 4 (the retired yaw anchor), m1 = QTM 6, m2 = QTM 7, m3 = the co-planar marker seen only at throwing yaws (QTM 3 or 5).
